name: Small Environmental Grant Scheme
summary: Four rounds a year of small grants in Australia for native flora and fauna conservation projects, including equipment and travel. Individuals and groups can apply; fencing, weed and pest control and tree planting are not funded.

amount.note: Usually around $10,000; up to $15,000, or larger up to $50,000 if a good fit

eligibility.rule: Project is about Australian flora and fauna conservation and is in the public interest
Not an animal or wildlife rescue and rehabilitation organisation
Academic applicant's research is not pure research, partners with an on-ground group, and can show it
Not a business, private company, start-up, environmental consultancy or consultant
Not a farm project with private or business interests, or raising private land value without lasting protection
Project is not a garden, arboretum or similar garden project
On-ground works are only proposed when they are really innovative

applicant_types.quote: Universities and academics can only apply for up to $5,000.

geography.quote: All around Australia, but only in Australia

access.quote: Using the on-line form. It only appears on-line when the grant round opens.

window.quote: There are four grant rounds every year.

amount.quote: Grants are usually around $10,000, but can be up to $15,000 or sometimes even bigger. Universities and academics can only apply for up to $5,000. Larger grants are available, anywhere up to $50,000 if it's a good fit for us.

effort.quote: Full Application if your EOI is accepted, Stage 2

eligibility.quote: Is your project about Australian flora and fauna conservation and in the public interest?
Do you have partners to work with?
Animal or wildlife rescue and rehabilitation organisations and their activities
But we don't fund pure research, you must be partnering with an 'on ground' group and be able to show it.
Businesses, private companies, or start ups Environmental consultancies or consultants
Farm projects with private or business interests, or private land owners who will be improving the value of their land without a guarantee of long term conservation protection
Gardens - bush food gardens, sensory gardens, veggie gardens, permaculture, chicken houses, water tanks, arboretums etc
On-ground works (planting, fencing or pest plant or animal control) unless really innovative.

after_award.quote: All grant recipients must fill in a final report on-line after 12 months.
